payload.artist_html: S. Manitkoon, U Deesri, B. Khalloufi,T. Nonsrirach, V Suteethorn, P Chanthasit, W Boonla, & E Buffetaut
payload.credit_html: "A New Basal Neornithischian Dinosaur from the Phu Kradung Formation (Upper Jurassic) of Northeastern Thailand"
payload.description_html: Reconstruction of Minimocursor phunoiensis gen. et sp. nov. (PRC 150) in left lateral view (except reversed images of the right jugal). Recovered elements of the holotype shown in white (A); holotype with referred materials, which are not to scale, shown in light purple (B). Drawings by Wongwech Chowchuvech.
